parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource to be tagged. Resource ID rules:

- Instance: instanceId

- Topic: Kafka\_alikafka\_instanceId\_topic

- Group: Kafka\_alikafka\_instanceId\_consumerGroup

For example: If the instance ID is alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx, the Topic name is test-topic, and the Group name is test-consumer-group, the resource IDs are alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx, Kafka\_alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx\_test-topic, and Kafka\_alikafka\_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx\_test-consumer-group respectively.

> Either the **ResourceId** or **Tag** parameter must be configured to query the tag list bound to resources. Otherwise, the API call fails.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Enumeration type. Valid values:

- **INSTANCE**: instance.

- **TOPIC**: topic.

- **CONSUMERGROUP**: consumer group.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource.

- If this parameter is empty, all tag keys are matched.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource.

- If the tag key is empty, this parameter must be empty. If this parameter is empty, all tag values are matched.

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.
